E. Bottom line

Question

Answer

Replace FreeSurfer?

No

Replace FastSurfer?

No — wraps it

Gaps with best alt wired?

DK, Destrieux, Schaefer, long, HA, BS/thal, clinical, module toggles, srun, hires

Gaps without alternatives?

Meta-SIF, manual edits, FreeView GUI, TRACULA/PET/fMRI, bit-identity, Infant FS (partial), native-LIT+split
